intro: The Mathematical Society hosts many events and works to spread math in the RGV. The following events are dedicated to math inolving seminars, activities, and meetings for our organization.

events.title: Lunch with the Professors Fall 2025
events.summary: On October 28, we'll have a networking event for students and professors offering free packaged lunch to attendees. RSVP using the link on the flyer.

events.title: Undergraduate Tutoring
events.summary: Tutoring for Math Classes provided by society members all week in Edinburg and Brownsville. Check the flyer for specific times and locations.

events.title: Mathematical Society Social Event
events.summary: A social event for the Mathematical Society will be hosted sometime this semester for members.
events.description: The Flyer for the event with more details will be posted shortly.

events.title: Algebra and Number Theory Seminar
events.summary: A new lecture from faculty and invited speakers every Thursday on topics of Number Theory and Algebra
